_comment: sim-robust-portal-floor-box-scope-v1, OPTION C (supersedes the scoping plan): keep the whole-slab flat-floor BOX from PR260, but make a ROLLING drive wheel rest ON the box at z=0 instead of sinking 10 mm to the redundant Ground_exterior sub-floor. MERGE the ONE top-level 'portal_floor_box' mapping below into the mission runtime-config ON TOP of the PR258 (sim-robust-heading-hold-bound) + PR259 (sim-robust-throat-momentum-launch) navigation blocks -- keep ALL of those keys ON. WHY option C and not scoping: CPU step 1 (data/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1/floorbox-obstacle-and-stepz-evidence.md) measured that in EVERY box run the rolling drive wheels rode at wheel_z 0.150 = resting at z=-0.010 = the Ground_exterior backdrop plane (120x120 m, top z=-0.010), NOT the Backroom_floor boundingCube (top z=0, which gives wheel_z 0.160 on the triangle mesh). The box let the rolling wheel penetrate its top down to that stiffer triangle-mesh plane, so the box floor was NEVER actually tested under a rolling wheel, and floorbox1a/1c's single-tick hard stops at x=-3.941 happened with the wheels on Ground_exterior (whose cooked diagonal is >13 m away -- the pin is NOT a Ground_exterior edge, NOT the removed Backroom_floor diagonal, NOT a z-step: the 1 cm sweep along y=15.25 is flat z=0 the whole way). Ground_exterior's collision is REDUNDANT for the mission: the real floors GRP_Structure/Floor (sales, x[-13,13] y[-11,11], z top 0) and Backroom_floor (x[-12,1] y[11,19.25], z top 0) abut at y=11 and cover the entire drivable area at z=0. FIX (opt-in, byte-identical off): with portal_floor_box on, (a) drop Ground_exterior's collider so there is no z=-0.010 plane to sink to, and (b) author physxCollision:restOffset=0 (+ a small contactOffset margin) on the Backroom_floor box so its rest-contact surface is exactly z=0. The wheel then rests on the box at z=0 => wheel_z 0.160 while rolling, the same as the mesh, and the box's diagonal-free floor is finally exercised under a moving wheel.
_integration_lane_steps: 1. Merge the single top-level key "portal_floor_box" (the mapping above) into the mission runtime config -- a scene-build key like "visuals"/"cage_collision", NOT under "navigation". The integration lane owns the ~/datasets configs; do NOT hand-edit them via a worker PR. Keep the PR258 + PR259 navigation blocks ON. ("portal_floor_box": true is equivalent -- drop_subfloor/rest_offset/contact_offset default to the values above.)

2. Confirm at boot the console prints 'PORTAL_FLOOR_BOX enabled=True drop_subfloor=True rest_offset=0.0 contact_offset=0.02 ...' from physics_setup. Absent/false => triangle-mesh floor with the sub-floor collider intact (byte-identical) and the sink/pin can recur.

3. Set RESTOCK_TRACE_CASTERS=1 (per-row casters.wheel_z + contact flags) and RESTOCK_NAV_PLAN_DIAG=1. Serialize every GPU run through flock /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, HEAVY_MB=2500 if whispr holds VRAM, NEVER --force, never touch whispr (pid 1339, ~2.2 GB).

4. PROOF A -- collect-only, TWICE: run_mobile_restock.py --stop-after collect from the cold seat. PASS (both): collect completes with NO 'ARM_CMD_ENVELOPE' track-error trip and NO 'MANIP_HOST_FAILED op=collect ... moveit_err=-4' abort at the pre-weld grasp press (the two faults floorbox1a hit). This checks the whole-slab box does not perturb the braked collect press now that the wheel rests at z=0.

5. PROOF B -- throat-only, THREE times: run_mobile_restock.py --start-at couple --stop-after outbound. PASS (all three): in the nav-trace, casters.wheel_z left/right == 0.160 (NOT 0.150) WHILE ROLLING through the lane (the wheel is on the box, not Ground_exterior), and grade with scripts/check_tow_traction.py (reached the bay, crosses x=-3.90, single_tick_stops=0, trace_has_casters=true), with NO 'NAV_BREAKAWAY enter' and NO 'coupled_no_progress' in the console. This is the first test of the box floor under a rolling wheel.
6. PROOF C -- full capstone: the complete cold cycle with portal_floor_box (this fragment) + PR258 + PR259 keys all ON. PASS: state=complete, the throat crossed with single_tick_stops=0.

_key_notes.portal_floor_box: bool or mapping; top-level scene-build key read by restock.scene.build -> twin.restock.portal_floor.resolve_config -> compose.author_static_colliders. enabled => Backroom_floor gets a box ('boundingCube') collider (no internal triangulation edge, PR260). drop_subfloor (default true when enabled) => the redundant Ground_exterior sub-floor backdrop (twin.colliders.SUBFLOOR_MESHES) gets NO collider, so the rolling wheel cannot sink to its z=-0.010 plane. rest_offset (default 0.0) / contact_offset (default 0.02 m) => PhysX physxCollision offsets on the box so the rest contact is exactly at the box top (z=0 => wheel_z = drive radius 0.16). Absent/false/None or {"enabled": false} => triangle-mesh floor + Ground_exterior collider present + no offsets, byte-identical to every prior run.
_key_notes.drop_subfloor: Dropping Ground_exterior's collider is safe for the mission because Floor (sales, z=0) + Backroom_floor (backroom, z=0) cover the whole robot/cart path and abut at y=11; Ground_exterior only matters outside x[-13,13] / y outside [-11,19.25], where nothing drives. Set drop_subfloor:false to keep it (then the sink can recur).

_scope_note: This fragment keeps the whole-slab box (collect station included) and fixes its rolling-wheel contact; it is NOT the lane-band scoping that was first explored (dropped per firstmate decision because the outbound tow and the collect drive wheel are adjacent to ~1 cm in Y with no gap for a clean join). It touches only the drive-floor box collider + the redundant sub-floor collider; it does not change PR207 drive force / caster_lift, PR258 heading-hold, PR259 momentum launch, any cart mass/friction, the arm, the grasp press, or any reverse motion. If the capstone tows onto the SALES floor (GRP_Structure/Floor, a triangle mesh with its own cooked diagonal; no real run has reached it), add 'Floor' to twin.colliders.DRIVE_FLOOR_MESHES as a follow-up. Full measured analysis: data/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1/floorbox-obstacle-and-stepz-evidence.md. CPU proof: scripts/check_portal_floor_seam.py, scripts/twin/tests/test_portal_floor_seam.py; policy twin/colliders.py (BOX / DRIVE_FLOOR_MESHES / SUBFLOOR_MESHES / offsets), authoring twin/compose.py (author_static_colliders flat_floor_box/drop_subfloor/offsets), wiring twin/restock/scene.py + physics_setup.py + twin/restock/portal_floor.py (resolve_config).
